# DomainNet Adverse External Fixed-Frame Evaluation

Verdict: `KILL`, transfer label `NOT_TRANSFER`

The protocol was sealed before DomainNet image download, decoding, and prediction. It evaluated 30 frozen PACS predictors on 12,027 images from six official DomainNet domains restricted to six PACS classes. Exact image-identity overlap with PACS was zero.

The primary 512-draw contract retained 54,000 primary rows, 162,000 total rows, and 1,512,000 candidate-method flags. No registered ResNet18 condition certified. ConvNeXt-Tiny certification was at most 1.3%, and the registered transfer gate failed. A more favorable 1,024-draw analysis is secondary and descriptive; it does not replace the primary verdict.

This directory contains the sealed protocol, reference pins, complete aggregate outcomes, denominators, analysis code, and decision. Raw DomainNet images, logits, and audit arrays are excluded.
